latest.d: - Reuters

latest.t: US freezes Microsoft green card program; Vance: 'You've got to hire American workers'
latest.d: Vice President JD Vance announces the suspension of Microsoft's (MSFT) PERM program, blocking the tech giant from sponsoring H-1B visa holders for permanent US residency after alleging the company replaced laid-off American employees with foreign workers.

stories.summary: The Trump administration suspended Microsoft from the PERM green card program, accusing it of displacing American workers with H-1B visa holders; JD Vance amplified the claims, and Microsoft denied them, saying it pays H-1B staff comparably and most US employees are American. Separately, Xbox formed a media division to license and adapt its game franchises.
